config.villagerguardgunners.guard_gunner: Guard Gunner Settings
Server-authoritative settings for Guard Villagers using TaCZ guns
Enable Guard Gun Combat
Allow Guard Villagers to use TaCZ guns. The server controls this setting.
Natural Guard Loadouts
One-time, difficulty-scaled TaCZ loadouts for newly spawned guards. Existing and manually equipped guards are unchanged.
Enable Natural Loadouts
Allow eligible newly spawned guards to replace their initial weapon with a datapack-defined TaCZ loadout.
Eligible Spawn Sources
Choose which initial spawn origins may receive automatic loadouts. Only structure spawning is enabled by default.
Replace Crossbows Only
Protect equipment from other mods by replacing only a guard's initial crossbow.
Nearby Population-Cap Radius
Radius for the one-time natural-gunner cap check, including authenticated guards in unloaded chunks.
Allow Explosive Natural Weapons
Allow datapack pools to issue weapons TaCZ identifies as explosive. All native blast safety remains active.
Easy Difficulty
Frequency, nearby cap, and datapack pool used on Easy difficulty.
Loadout Chance
Chance from 0 to 1 that an otherwise eligible new guard receives this loadout.
Maximum Nearby Natural Gunners
Maximum naturally equipped guards within the configured radius. Set to 0 to disable Easy loadouts.
Loadout Pool ID
Namespaced datapack natural-loadout pool selected on Easy difficulty.
Normal Difficulty
Frequency, nearby cap, and datapack pool used on Normal difficulty.
Loadout Chance
Chance from 0 to 1 that an otherwise eligible new guard receives this loadout.
Maximum Nearby Natural Gunners
Maximum naturally equipped guards within the configured radius. Set to 0 to disable Normal loadouts.
Loadout Pool ID
Namespaced datapack natural-loadout pool selected on Normal difficulty.
Hard Difficulty
Frequency, nearby cap, and datapack pool used on Hard difficulty.
Loadout Chance
Chance from 0 to 1 that an otherwise eligible new guard receives this loadout.
Maximum Nearby Natural Gunners
Maximum naturally equipped guards within the configured radius. Set to 0 to disable Hard loadouts.
Loadout Pool ID
Namespaced datapack natural-loadout pool selected on Hard difficulty.
Squads and Commands
Bounded server-authoritative dispatch for temporary orders issued with a Squad Command Ledger.
Command Dispatch Radius
Maximum distance from the player for the one-time loaded squad-member query.
Maximum Affected Guards
Hard limit on authorized squad members changed by one command.
Positional Command Duration
Lifetime in ticks for Rally, Defend, Hold, and Fall Back commands.
Focus Target Duration
Lifetime in ticks for Focus Target commands.
Defend Radius
Distance guards may move from a Defend command point.
Air Command Range
Projection distance for positional commands issued while looking into the air.

config.villagerguardgunners.guard_gunner: Combat
Target acquisition, range, and aiming settings. TaCZ still controls each weapon's statistics.
Required Visible Ticks
Ticks a guard must continuously see its target before firing. Set to 0 for no visibility delay.
Maximum Firing Range
Maximum distance at which a guard may fire, in blocks. TaCZ effective range still controls the guard's preferred combat distance and damage falloff.
Close-Range Distance
Distance in blocks at which a guard considers its target too close and tries to retreat.
Aim Tolerance
Maximum aiming error accepted before firing, in degrees.
Movement
Navigation behavior while guards are using TaCZ guns
Approach Speed
Navigation speed modifier while approaching a target.
Retreat Speed
Navigation speed modifier while retreating from a target that is too close.
Reposition Speed
Navigation speed modifier while finding a safe firing lane.
Friendly Reposition Delay
Ticks before retrying a firing lane blocked by a protected entity.
Weapon-Specific Tactics
Profile selection and bounded guard behavior controls. These settings do not change TaCZ weapon statistics.
Gun-Type Profiles
Map TaCZ gun type labels to tactical profiles. Keys ignore surrounding whitespace and capitalization; conflicting aliases fall back safely.
Per-Gun Profile Overrides
Choose a profile for an exact TaCZ gun ID. Explosive safety cannot be disabled by an override.
Generalist Profile
Balanced fallback behavior that preserves the existing guard combat settings.
Preferred Range Multiplier
Multiplier applied to TaCZ effective range when choosing an approach distance.
Retreat Distance Multiplier
Multiplier applied to the configured close-range retreat distance.
Visible Ticks Adjustment
Ticks added to or removed from the configured continuous-visibility requirement.
Aim Tolerance Multiplier
Multiplier applied to aim tolerance. Smaller values require more precise aim.
Use Effective-Range Firing Limit
Also limit firing distance using TaCZ effective range instead of only the global hard cap.
Maximum Firing Range Multiplier
Multiplier applied to TaCZ effective range when the profile-specific firing limit is enabled.
Skirmisher Profile
Mobile close-to-medium-range behavior intended for pistols and submachine guns.

Rules of Engagement
Server-authoritative firing policy applied after Guard Villagers chooses a target.
Engagement Mode
Choose whether guards follow normal Guard Villagers targets, restrict proactive fire to hostile mobs, retaliate defensively, or hold fire.
Defensive Aggression Memory
Ticks after an attack during which DEFENSIVE guards may engage the attacker.

config.villagerguardgunners.guard_gunner: Safety
Friendly-fire clearance settings. Core fail-closed protections cannot be disabled.
Protected-Entity Clearance
Extra clearance around protected entities when validating a shot, in blocks.
Preserve Blocks from Guard Explosions
Prevent guard-owned TaCZ projectile explosions from destroying blocks while retaining their native effects on hostile entities.
Explosive Radius Standoff Multiplier
Multiply the resolved TaCZ explosion radius when calculating the guard's non-bypassable minimum firing distance.
Additional Explosive Standoff
Additional blocks added after the explosion-radius multiplier when calculating minimum firing distance.
Modpack Ally Protection
Entity tags, explicit type lists, ownership, and team controls shared by every guard-gun safety layer.
Protect Owned Entities
Protect living entities with an owner UUID, including vanilla and compatible modded tameables.
Protect Allied Entities
Protect living entities Minecraft considers allied to the guard, including entities on the same scoreboard team.
Additional Protected Entity Types
Namespaced living entity type IDs to protect in addition to the guard_allies datapack tag.
Excluded Entity Types
Namespaced living entity type IDs excluded from configurable ally protection. Guards and their owners remain protected.
Ammunition Quality of Life
Passive pickup and bounded emergency sharing controls. TaCZ remains authoritative for ammunition compatibility and reloading.
Pick Up Dropped Ammunition
Allow guards to collect compatible TaCZ ammunition they naturally walk over without pathfinding to it.
Dropped Ammunition Pickup Radius
Maximum passive pickup distance in blocks. Smaller values reduce the area checked around dropped ammunition.
Share Ammunition Between Guards
Allow a dry guard to request compatible loose ammunition from a nearby eligible guard.
Ammunition Sharing Radius
Maximum emergency sharing distance in blocks. Searches occur only after a guard runs out of compatible reserve ammunition.
Donor Reserve Magazines
Whole attachment-adjusted magazines a donor guard keeps before sharing loose ammunition.
Require Matching Guard Owners
Restrict sharing to guards with the same owner while still allowing two unowned guards to share.
Village Armory Resupply
Bounded automatic ammunition resupply from loaded Village Armories. Searches never scan the world or force chunks to load.
Enable Village Armory Resupply
Allow otherwise-idle guards with low physical reserve ammunition to use eligible loaded Village Armories.
Need Check Interval
Ticks between staggered ammunition-need assessments. Higher values reduce server work but react more slowly.
Armory Search Radius
Maximum distance in blocks for the loaded-Armory index query. Unloaded chunks are never searched or loaded.
Maximum Candidate Armories
Maximum loaded Armories inspected during one request before the search fails closed.
Low-Reserve Trigger
Request resupply when physical reserve drops below this many attachment-adjusted magazines. Zero disables automatic requests.
Target Reserve
Desired physical reserve after withdrawal. A value below the low-reserve trigger fails closed.
Resupply Movement Speed
Navigation speed used only while travelling toward an already-reserved Village Armory.
Request Lifetime
Maximum lifetime in ticks of one immutable ammunition request.
Reservation Lifetime
Maximum time in ticks that one guard may reserve a specific Armory supply slot.
Success Cooldown
Delay in ticks after a successful withdrawal before the guard may reassess Armory need.
No-Supply Retry Delay
Delay in ticks after no compatible loaded Village Armory can be selected.
Unreachable Retry Delay
Base delay in ticks after bounded navigation cannot reach a reserved Village Armory.
Advanced Performance
Scheduling controls. Lower intervals react faster but require more server work.
Visibility Sample Interval
Ticks between target visibility samples. Lower values react faster but use more CPU.
Movement Decision Interval
Ticks between combat movement decisions. Lower values react faster but use more CPU.
Path Recalculation Interval
Ticks between navigation path recalculations. Lower values respond faster to changes but use more CPU.
Gun Data Refresh Interval
Ticks between cached TaCZ gun-data refreshes.
Unsafe-Shot Cache Duration
Ticks an unsafe-shot result may be reused across ticks. Set to 0 to keep only same-tick reuse.
Reposition Progress Interval
Ticks between checks that a repositioning guard is making progress.
